{{Conjecture|legends}}
A '''civil war''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Thisspias/Legends|Thisspias]] following the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. The conflict was brief yet extremely [[Blood/Legends|bloody]] and saw the return to power of the planet's [[Blood Monarch/Legends|Blood Monarch]], the previous [[crown prince of Thisspias]].<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
